title: Claude Haiku 4.5 incident01 blinded evidence-variant experiment
research_question: How do three blinded evidence variants affect Claude Haiku 4.5 reasoning and broker-mediated response requests for incident01 across four instruction profiles relative to a contemporaneous control?
hypothesis: Evidence manipulation and instruction framing may affect model reasoning and requested actions, while CyberBroker will prevent every policy-denied effect.

conditions.description: Every model-requested response action is mediated by CyberBroker under policy version 0.1.

notes: Sixteen-cell exploratory experiment: incident01 by four instruction profiles by contemporaneous BASE plus three opaque evidence variants. Uses the pinned Claude Haiku 4.5 snapshot. Evaluator-only mappings are excluded and every first attempt is retained.
